tasks.short: Read a work order or blueprint for the machine setup.

steps.what: Read orders or blueprints to determine specified tolerances and sequences of operations for machine setup.

tasks.design: The setter reads the work order and the blueprint and decides the tolerances and the operation sequence for this setup. No feed replaces that reading. A production-count link in this minor group records output on other tasks and does not determine a forging tolerance.
tasks.previous_blocker: The tolerance sits on the drawing for this part, and the sequence depends on the heat and the die that is on the floor.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the group digest shortens blueprint reading. The deterministic records work is a tally of pieces and stops, which this task does not do.
tasks.still_hard: A misread tolerance or a wrong sequence scraps the forging. The setter has to match the drawing to this machine.
tasks.human_edge: Judging which callout on the drawing governs this operation, and which sequence the machine can actually run.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The setter still reads the order and still decides the tolerance and the sequence.

reach.role: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
reach.task: Check a forged part against the tolerance on the order
reach.learn: Which callout on the blueprint is the one that governs this operation.

evidence.claim: Reading a forging work order or blueprint to decide tolerances and the operation sequence stays with the setter. The group's production-count feed records pieces and stops on other tasks.

assumptions: The work order and the blueprint already exist before this task. This task is the reading and the determination, not a second typing into a controller.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this shop's work order is paper or on a screen. Either way the setter still reads it.
research_questions: Does this setter type the tolerance into a second controller after reading it, or only read it?

already_counted.description: The reading and the determination both remain in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. The reading is the work, and no second entry is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Talk with other workers about the machine setup.

steps.what: Confer with other workers about machine setups and operational specifications.

tasks.design: The setter talks with other workers about the setup and the operational specification. That talk stays in person at the machine. It is not a written notice and not a handover of production counts.
tasks.previous_blocker: The other worker knows what the last heat did. That is said at the machine, not held as a field the setter can look up.
tasks.enabler_now: Setting up stays manual in this group. A handover of production counts is a different task. Conferring about a setup stays a conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Two operators can disagree on a setup. Someone has to say which specification applies to this part.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing what went wrong on the last run and deciding whether this setup should change.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The setter still confers with the other workers about the setup.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
reach.task: Settle a setup disagreement between operators
reach.learn: What the other operator already tried on this die.

evidence.claim: Agreeing a forging setup with other workers stays a conversation at the machine. The group's note on free text is a handover of production counts, which is a different task.

assumptions: This task is the conversation. The setter does not then type the agreement into a second system.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether a supervisor is in the conversation or only other operators. The talk still happens.
research_questions: Does this shop write the agreed setup down after the talk, or is the talk the whole task?

already_counted.description: The conversation remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. The talk is the work, and no second note or send is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose the dies and bolt them to the forging machine.

steps.what: Select positioning fixtures, stops, and specified dies.
Bolt and align fixtures on rams and anvils, forging rolls, or presses and hammers.

tasks.design: The setter selects the fixtures, stops and dies the order names, then aligns and bolts them to the ram, anvil, forging roll, press or hammer. Both acts stay at the machine. No records feed bolts a die.
tasks.previous_blocker: The die has to seat on this ram or hammer. That fit is physical.
tasks.enabler_now: Setting up stays manual in this group. Machine-count tools and gear-calculation tools cover other tasks. They do not select or bolt a forging die.
tasks.still_hard: A die that is the right number but seated wrong strikes off centre. The setter sees that while bolting.
tasks.human_edge: Feeling whether the stop, the fixture and the die are true before the first blow.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The setter still chooses the tooling and still bolts it.

reach.task: Set or dress the die the setter will bolt in
reach.learn: How the die face and the stop must line up before the first blow.

evidence.claim: Selecting forging fixtures and dies, then aligning and bolting them to the ram, anvil, roll, press or hammer, stays with the setter. The group's machine-count and gear-calculation work is other tasks.

assumptions: Selecting the tooling is the shorter part, about a third of the task. Aligning and bolting it to the ram, anvil, roll, press or hammer is the longer part.
These shares are the time at the rack and the time at the machine. They are not the kind or means priors.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether a tool crib already stages the die before the setter arrives. If it does, the selecting share shrinks and the bolting share does not.
research_questions: Does a tool maker bolt this die, or does the forging setter bolt it?

already_counted.description: Selecting the tooling and bolting it both remain.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. Choosing the die and bolting it are the work, and neither act is removed, so the low stays at zero.
